issues.description: Path comparison between changedFiles and isIncluded filename lacks normalization and may silently filter everything
issues.detail: isIncluded does this.changedFiles.includes(filename) after slash+cleanUrl on one side, while findChangedFiles returns raw git output. Absolute-vs-relative or Windows separator mismatches cause every file to miss, silently producing empty coverage. Canonicalize both sides to one shape (absolute, slashed, cleaned) at the boundary and store it.

issues.description: Null/undefined return from findChangedFiles silently disables filtering and reports full coverage
issues.detail: When VitestGit.findChangedFiles returns null (not a git repo, bad ref), changedFiles is set to undefined and isIncluded reports coverage for everything. The user asked for changed-only coverage; silent fallthrough to full coverage is the opposite. Warn or throw instead of degrading the postcondition.

issues.description: globCache key no longer a pure function of filename once changedFiles filter is applied
issues.detail: Cache value now depends on (filename, changedFiles) but the key is filename alone. If isIncluded runs before onTestRunStart, or in re-runs where changedFiles changes, the cache is poisoned. Either include changedFiles state in the key or enforce strict ordering as a documented invariant.

issues.description: onTestRunStart hook duplicated across three call sites in core.ts instead of consolidated
issues.detail: core.ts manually calls coverageProvider?.onTestRunStart?.() after _testRun.start(...) in three places. A fourth code path will forget it. Fold the call into _testRun.start or a helper so the lifecycle has one source of truth.

issues.description: CLI transform handles boolean inputs the CLI parser cannot produce
issues.detail: The transform checks value === true and value === false, but CLI args arrive as strings. The dead branches signal confusion about the precondition. Either delete the boolean checks or document why programmatic config reaches the same path.

issues.description: changedFiles stored as array and scanned with .includes on the hot path
issues.detail: isIncluded does a linear array search per file; with many files this is O(n*m). The right structure is a Set<string> built once in onTestRunStart. Lookup becomes O(1) with no change to the invalidation story.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the feature is the right shape but the path-matching layer is fragile and the lifecycle wiring is duplicated. Two P1 correctness risks dominate: changedFiles is compared by raw string equality against differently-normalized filenames (likely silent empty coverage on Windows or absolute/relative mismatches), and a null return from findChangedFiles silently degrades to full coverage. The globCache is no longer a pure function of its key once the filter is in play. Secondary concerns: the onTestRunStart hook is hand-pasted into three call sites, the CLI transform has dead boolean branches, and an array is used where a Set belongs. NEEDS-WORK before merge.
